about: PSK fixtures: recipes for shack_sdr's PSK test transmitter, src/psk/tx.rs (12 kHz audio, carrier at 1000 Hz + offset_hz, SNR in 2.5 kHz; interferer = [offset_hz, level_db, baud, text]) and the sha256 of the float32 samples each makes. Written by tools/psk_golden.py.
